verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud compute platform like Modal, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a managed cloud service ('Modal handles the infrastructure', 'running AI workloads in the cloud'). The open-source GitHub repo is a client SDK and CLI for talking to the hosted platform, not a self-hostable core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
